issues.title: [PERF] Latência de leitura acima de 1 ms
acceptance_summary: get_cf consults Bloom filter before SSTable I/O — negative reads don't touch disk
Block cache implemented (Arc<LruCache>) with configurable size via LsmConfig
scan_cf skips SSTables whose [min_key, max_key] doesn't intersect the query range
Merge iterator uses BinaryHeap (min-heap) for O(log N) merge
Benchmark: Bloom filter negative read < 10 µs
No unwrap() on critical read paths

todos.description: Wire KV cache into VersionSet — add real Arc<Mutex<LruCache>> field, propagate from Engine, add get/put methods
Add KV-level cache check in VersionSet::get() before data lookup; populate after read
Remove expect() from MergeIterator::key()/value() — guard with is_valid()
Remove panic!() from TableIterator::key()/value() — guard with is_valid()
Remove panic!() from InternalMemTableIterator::key()/value() — guard with is_valid()
Add unit test: Bloom filter prevents data lookup for absent key
Add unit test: Block cache hit returns cached value on repeated read
Add unit test: scan_cf skips non-intersecting SSTables
Add benchmark assertions for thresholds <10µs memtable, <500µs warm SSTable, <10µs Bloom neg, <5ms scan 1k
Run cargo clippy -- -D warnings and cargo test --all-features
